title: List of designated additives
journal: Japan Food Chemical Research Foundation, English translation of Appended Table 1 of the Enforcement Regulations under the Food Sanitation Act, list as of 1 March 2024
funder: not stated. The page is published by the Japan Food Chemical Research Foundation; the Consumer Affairs Agency food additives page links the Foundation's Japanese version as the list of designated additives (Appended Table 1 of the Enforcement Regulations).
result: Designated additives are those designated by the Prime Minister (by the Minister of Health, Labour and Welfare until March 2024), based on Article 12 of the Food Sanitation Act, as substances unlikely to harm human health; the designation covers chemically synthesised and natural substances. Appended Table 1 of the Enforcement Regulations held 476 designated additives as of 1 March 2024. Citric acid is entry No. 113; calcium citrate, monopotassium and tripotassium citrate and trisodium citrate are also listed.
